_help: Contact section: headings, the 'What happens next' card and the contact form (labels, dropdown options, button text, error messages, and the popup shown after sending; {name} in the popup title becomes the visitor's first name). Form submissions are emailed to the address in CONTACT_TO_EMAIL — not set here.
title: Let us make it easy
intro: Tell us what you need. We will read it, tell you honestly whether we can help, and reply with the next step.

next.title: What happens next
steps: Fill in the form. It takes about two minutes.
We read it and reply by email or WhatsApp.
We agree the next step together, with no obligation.
